issue_context.title: `openssl ecparam -list_curves` is broken on master
issue_context.body:
`openssl ecparam -list_curves` is broken since 1dbb67c4f1a3aec7f4026e43257b33ffad665ba5.

It now first wants to read an EC parameters file, before printing the list of supported curves as usual:
```openssl ecparam -name secp256r1 | openssl ecparam -list_curves```

Reverting 1dbb67c4f1a3aec7f4026e43257b33ffad665ba5 restores the original behaviour.

review_comments: Would it make more sense to also move this `bio_open_owner` call earlier too - rather that repeat the code?
No, that would recreate the issue that #25552 was resolving.
